name: switch__consecutive_echoes_monotonic_exchange
description: Two back-to-back CCU STATE echoes on the same OnOff subscription each emit ReportData on a fresh bridge-initiated exchange distinct from the commissioner-opened Subscribe exchange. The harness verifies each report round-trips independently (fire → expect_tx → status_response → status_ack log). The monotonic-allocator guarantee (consecutive nextOutboundExchangeID calls produce strictly increasing IDs) is locked by TestSendInitiatedIM_MonotonicallyIncreasing; this scenario locks the observable corollary: neither report reuses the Subscribe exchange. Cross-step ordering (exchange1 < exchange2) is not yet assertable in Phase C — that comparison moves to Phase D fault-injection extensions.
